question: What were LATAM's total completed revenue and total marketing spend in 2025?

sql_attempts.sql: SELECT r.region_name, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31' AND o.status = 'completed' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount) ELSE 0 END) AS completed_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN m.month >= '2025-01' AND m.month <= '2025-12' THEN m.amount ELSE 0 END) AS marketing_spend FROM regions AS r LEFT JOIN customers AS c ON c.region_id = r.region_id LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id LEFT JOIN marketing_spend AS m ON m.region_id = r.region_id WHERE r.region_name = 'LATAM' GROUP BY r.region_id, r.region_name LIMIT 500

SELECT r.region_name, COALESCE(rev.completed_revenue, 0) AS completed_revenue, COALESCE(sp.marketing_spend, 0) AS marketing_spend FROM regions AS r LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.region_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS completed_revenue FROM orders AS o JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY c.region_id) AS rev ON rev.region_id = r.region_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT region_id, SUM(amount) AS marketing_spend FROM marketing_spend WHERE month >= '2025-01' AND month <= '2025-12' GROUP BY region_id) AS sp ON sp.region_id = r.region_id WHERE r.region_name = 'LATAM' LIMIT 500
